name: Milo Machado-Graner
bio: Milo Machado Graner (born August 31, 2008) is a French actor. In 2023, he starred as Daniel, the visually impaired son of Sandra Voyter, in Justine Triet's courtroom drama Anatomy of a Fall, which won the Palme d'Or at Cannes. He received a number of accolades for his performance, including Critics Choice and Lumières Award nominations.

credits.title: Anatomie d'une chute : L'ascension de Justine Triet
credits.overview: The documentary explores the Triet method by diving behind the scenes of the film Anatomy of a Fall, Palme d'Or at Cannes in 2023.
